Container.Name: Nommable
Container.Overview: Nommable is a self-hosted recipe management system, meal planner, smart shopping list, pantry tracker, and batch cooking assistant running in a single container with SQLite storage and optional BYOK AI features. On first launch, visit /setup to complete the 5-step onboarding wizard.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the Nommable web interface and API (container listens on 3001).

Config.Name: App Data (/data)
Config.Description: Persistent storage for the SQLite database (/data/nommable.db) and uploaded recipe images (/data/uploads).

Config.Name: BETTER_AUTH_SECRET
Config.Description: Required secret for signing Better Auth user sessions (32+ random characters; generate with: openssl rand -hex 32).

Config.Name: ENCRYPTION_KEY
Config.Description: Required 64-character hex key (32 bytes) for AES-256-GCM encryption of stored AI API keys and SMTP credentials (generate with: openssl rand -hex 32).

Config.Name: CORS_ORIGIN
Config.Description: Allowed origin URL for browser requests (set to your Unraid server URL or reverse-proxy domain, e.g. http://192.168.1.50:8992).

Config.Name: DB_PATH
Config.Description: Path to the SQLite database file inside the container.

Config.Name: UPLOAD_DIR
Config.Description: Directory for uploaded recipe photos inside the container.
